steps.detail: tokens_build --check: tokens.json and tokens.css match the source (500 tokens).
500 tokens, 620 :root properties, 91 short names in each of 4 surface classes and the light and dark themes, 0 failures
500 tokens, 30 derived colors and tints, 205 semantic color cells measured, light theme 69 roles on newsprint, dark theme 61 roles on charcoal, 0 failures
clean files pass; plants caught 41 of 41

plants.plant: The device's dark setting overriding data-oa-theme="light" on the root
plants.failure: (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block: expected a single :root:not([data-oa-theme="light"]) rule, so data-oa-theme="light" wins over the device; found :root

plants.plant: A short name missing from the light theme (the focus ring)

plants.plant: The dark theme moved from Charcoal to Prussian
plants.failure: theme record: DR-204 sets the light theme on Newsprint and the dark theme on Charcoal

plants.plant: A version rise with no change note
plants.failure: root: version 6.0.0-gate2.8 has no change note (version, change, reason) at the head of changeNotes (section 7, step 6)
